launches.title: Smartbase: automated PO entry for manufacturers
launches.tagline: We help manufacturers (e.g. job shops) remove the manual work from order entry.
launches.body:
Hey! We’re [Sam](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sam-goldman/) and [Taira](https://www.linkedin.com/in/taira-fujioka1999420/), the co-founders of [Smartbase](https://smartbase.so/).

[**https://youtu.be/EsevybYIIrA**](https://youtu.be/EsevybYIIrA)

# **The Problem**

Today, incoming purchase orders are still entered into the ERP by hand.

This process often requires multiple full-time employees, especially for manufacturers doing custom or high-mix work.

Orders arrive in every format imaginable: paper, email, fax, and sometimes even handwritten.

# **The Solution**

Here’s how Smartbase automates order entry:

1. **Import POs**: Upload scanned orders to Smartbase, or connect Smartbase to your inbox for emailed orders.
2. **Automatic data extraction**: Our AI turns even the messiest POs into ERP-ready data using your custom business rules (e.g. customer-specific pricing).
3. **Review and approve**: Review orders in our dashboard, then click approve. They'll appear in your ERP.
4. **Automatically print travelers**: Optionally, Smartbase can automatically print the travelers from your ERP.

# **Our Team**

We’ve worked on factory floors, sat side-by-side with employees to learn their workflows, and even slept at a factory.

Sam (CEO) previously founded a DevOps platform that raised $2M. Taira (CTO) was the youngest SDE 2 at AWS SageMaker Inference, where he built AI infrastructure for enterprises such as Salesforce.

# **Our Ask**

If you know someone who works at a manufacturer, we’d love an intro! Just email [sam@smartbase.so](mailto:sam@smartbase.so) to connect us.

If you’re interested in using Smartbase, schedule some time to chat [here](https://calendly.com/d/cr5v-f9f-kb3/smartbase).
